description: This file provides utility functions for making API GET requests in a web frontend, including URL construction, handling authentication headers, URL resolution, and response processing.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is absolute (starts with http or https).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API calls, preferring window location, environment variable, or fallback to relative path.

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a path, correctly handling absolute URLs and /api prefixes.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl(url, explicitOrgId)
methods.description: Appends organization_id or tenant_id as a query parameter to the URL if not already present.

methods.name: apiGet(pathOrUrl, options = {})
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path or URL, resolves the full URL, appends organization ID, includes auth headers, and processes the JSON/text response, throwing on errors.
